name: mech-87-heavy-block-room
source: mech-87-heavy-block Test Level: a heavy block (H) on the way to a switch plate (S) holding a switch gate (D) to the orb and warp; a patroller (E) crosses the pushing tile behind the block, so a player who starts pushing without watching the patrol is caught while straining on the first push and restarts, while waiting for the patrol to pass lets the two-pushes-per-tile push through; power gloves (V) in the south-west make it one push per tile
